bio_md:
# 宋理宗 · 主要事迹

赵昀为[[n-song-tai-zu|太祖]]十世孙，史弥远矫诏拥立，嘉定十七年（1224）即位，改元宝庆。

端平元年（1234）宋蒙联军灭金于蔡州，[[jin-ai-zong|金哀宗]]自缢，金亡；史弥远死后理宗亲政，改元端平，追谥朱熹、周程诸子，理学官学化于此达于极致，「崇道学」为一代政风。然同年出兵收复三京，史称「端平入洛」，旋为蒙古所败，宋蒙和约遂破，蒙古成为最大邻敌。此后理宗渐怠于政，晚年宠任贾似道，蒙军南下之势已不可挡。

景定五年（1264）理宗崩，侄赵禥即位，是为[[s-song-du|度宗]]。

After Shi Miyuan's death Lizong governed in person: he changed the era to Duanping, posthumously honored Zhu Xi and the Cheng brothers, and carried Neo-Confucianism to its official apogee - the "reverence for dao-learning" that defined his political style. That same year, however, his troops marched to recover the Three Capitals, the "Duanping recovery," and were routed by the Mongols; the Song-Mongol compact broke and Mongolia became the great neighbor. Lizong's energy then waned; in his later years he entrusted Jia Sidao while Mongol armies pressed south.
